newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Three die in Malaysian Cessna plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Three die in Malaysian Cessna plane crash.

text.p: A light plane being used to film a cycle race crashed on the Malaysian island of Langkawi, killing all three people on board.

The Cessna 172 crashed into a mangrove swamp shortly after Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad had flagged off racers for the last leg of the Tour de Langkawi national cycle championship, the national Bernama news agency reported late on Sunday.

Bernama quoted Langkawi police spokesman Wan Ali Abu Shahmah who said the dead were Malaysia's Filem Negara national film company cameramen Abdul Razak Md Nor, 43, and Ishak Latif, 32, and pilot Nik Alfian Nik Abdul Ghani, 26.
